property_summary: Invariant: after any call to transferOwnership(newOwner) performed by any caller, the contract's owner() remains unchanged unless the caller was the current owner — the reference enforces onlyOwner so only the current owner can change owner, while the mutant (removed require) allows non-owners to change owner and thus can violate this rule for some caller/newOwner inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require check so onlyOwner no longer restricts execution (deleted require), allowing anyone to call transferOwnership and change owner.
